root_cause.text: The batman-adv bridge loop avoidance subsystem leaked a `backbone_gw` reference because the `batadv_bla_add_claim` function failed to call `batadv_backbone_gw_put()` on the error path when a claim hash insertion failed or found a duplicate.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `batadv_backbone_gw_put(backbone_gw);` within the `if (unlikely(hash_added != 0))` block in `net/batman-adv/bridge_loop_avoidance.c`, directly addressing the CVE description which states the function "leaked a reference to the backbone_gw" when failing to insert a new claim into the hash.
